---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

dset0="erdEtopoSeafloorGradient"
dset1="erdSrtm30plusSeafloorGradient"

vars= [{"id":"0","name":"magnitude_gradient","title":"Magnitude of Sea Floor Depth Gradient","type":"1","nlev":"100","levmin":"0","levmax":"1"},
				{"id":"1","name":"x_gradient","title":"East-West Gradient of Sea Floor Depth","type":"1","nlev":"100","levmin":"-1","levmax":"1"},
				{"id":"2","name":"y_gradient","title":"North-South Gradient of Sea Floor Depth","type":"1","nlev":"100","levmin":"-1","levmax":"1"},
				{"id":"3","name":"sea_floor_depth","title":"Sea Floor Depth","type":"2","nlev":"100","levmin":"0","levmax":"1"}]

function geturl(dset,thisvar,fmt){
    var varname = thisvar.name
		var start="https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/"+dset+"."+fmt+"?";
		var scnd="[(20.0):(50.0)][(230.0):(255.0)]&.draw=surface&.vars=longitude%7Clatitude%7C";
		var last="&.colorBar=%7C%7C%7C%7C%7C&.bgColor=0xffccccff";
		var url=start+varname+scnd+varname+last;
		return url;
		}
```


## Download ETOPO Seafloor Gradients

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px;">
  ${vars.map(thisvar => html`
    <div style="flex: 1 1 30%; min-width: 200px;">
      <h4>${thisvar.title}</h4>
        <img src="${geturl(dset0, thisvar, 'png')}" style="max-width: 100%;" />
      <br><br>
      <a href="${geturl(dset0, thisvar, 'html')}" target="_blank">Download and subset on ERDDAP&#8482;</a>
    </div>
  `)}
</div>`
```
